seth.name: Seth Jones
seth.bio: As a student at Northern Arizona University, I am currently pursing degrees in both Electrical Engineering and Cybersecurity. I have a passion for cutting edge technology in autonomous systems and robotics. For my junior thesis, I focused on the development of drone based LIDAR for mapping geographic topology. The efforts of that project directly support the development of self-driving cars through LIDAR development and prolonged autonomous navigation. I’m always looking for new ways to bridge the gap between scientific theory and real-world engineering applications.

dante.name: Dante Palmieri
dante.bio: Hi, I am Dante Palmieri and I am a Computer Engineering major at NAU. My role on the team is helping to integrate hardware and software interfaces for our buggy.

devon.name: Devon Allan
devon.bio: Hi, my name is Devon Allan and I am the wiring lead on the NAU Boeing Autonomous team. I plan to wire the different subsystems as well as help integrate the sensors for the kart to become self driving. My future plans are to design effects circuits and amplifiers and merge my musical interest with my engineering degree.

evan.name: Evan Hudak
evan.bio: My name is Evan Hudak, and I am a Computer Engineering major at Northern Arizona University. I have experience designing small-scale circuits, programming microcontrollers, developing a functional operating system simulator, and implementing artificial intelligence algorithms, including convolutional and recurrent neural networks. For my capstone project, I am applying this background to support the vehicle braking system and contribute to the development of decision-making algorithms for on-road operation. After graduation, I aspire to work with embedded hardware systems and advanced computing technologies.

lily.name: Lily Quintanar
lily.bio: Hi my name is Lily Quintanar. I am studying multidisciplinary engineering with an emphasis in audio engineering and am also pursuing a minor in mathematics. I have taken many electrical engineering courses and am passionate about the creativity of engineering and the intersection it has with the arts, specifically with music and sound. I have enjoyed being challenged by the technical aspects of this project and am looking forward to applying these skills to future endeavors.
